label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: On 26 Oct the Marketplace chatbot work closed: the integration (MT-1626), logged-in user handling (MT-1627) and backend support (MT-1629) moved from In Prod to Done. The same day Kannan Elangovan raised a P1 bug, broken product links from the chatbot in production (MT-1750, no due date). In the Magento 2.4.9 upgrade (MT-1615, due 31 Oct) Parth, shubham kuchwar and Naman Bapna moved ten more module subtasks to Dev (MT-1662 to MT-1685) and started the Magetrend email upgrade (MT-1660), Naman Bapna raised a Part-2 upgrade story (MT-1753, due 16 Nov) and two email-module reviews (MT-1755, MT-1756, due 31 Oct), and is fixing GraphQL APIs that return 403 for signed-in users on Dev (MT-1754). The GDPR and SOC-2 work (MT-1616) was re-dated from 31 Oct to 30 Nov. The cross-application logout fix (MT-1745) is In Prod and the homepage H1 fix (MT-1749) is in UAT. 13 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Kunal Jangid closed the hotfix that switches the chatbot on in production (MR-1416) and the H1 tags on 18 pages (MR-1361), and Vishnu kumar yadav closed the Dev sign-up redirect bug (MR-1065). Figma validation of the v1.2 pages started on 26 Oct: Nuclear Energy page issues (MR-1419 with six subtasks) and Partners page issues (MR-1428, MR-1429), all due 30 Oct; the Partners page design update (MR-1402) is in Dev Testing and the SLA and Terms page (MR-1404) is in progress. Vishnu kumar yadav was given the PHP 8.2.35 security patch for the Marketing CMS (MR-1422, Highest, due 29 Oct). A second v1.2 revamp story with no due date (MR-1411) still duplicates MR-1379. 15 items are past due, down from 17.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: On 26 Oct 100 USP items moved to UAT/Staging, 73 of them from Deployed In Dev, among them the IAM and role security story with its nine subtasks (USP-4234), the tax stories (USP-4268 to USP-4278), invoice issuing from the CRM (USP-4284, USP-4287 to USP-4289, straight from TODO), the payment option stories, the team, chat and dashboard cards, the request-quote wait step (USP-4395 to USP-4400) and the AI Factory storage configurator (USP-4403 to USP-4411). The S1 subscription calculation error (USP-4204) and the S2 backend error cluster (USP-4199) are in UAT; the S1 Document API 502 (USP-4231, due 30 Oct) is still TODO. Livian Stefan Stan raised and deployed ten performance, security and CI tasks to UAT (USP-4417 to USP-4426). Cășvan Marcel raised a management networking story (USP-4413) and three bugs due 2 Nov, including a security bug where pricing rule formulas run through Python eval with full builtins (USP-4414), plus a send-quote deadlock fix already in UAT (USP-4412). Two items were closed as Won't Do (USP-3908, USP-4319) and three Communication Hub and Support Hub stories moved to Backlog (USP-4294, USP-4303, USP-4335). Past-due items rose from 123 to 127 because seven of the new UAT tasks carry 24 and 25 Oct dates; the Highest security bug with no due date (USP-4369) is still TODO.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: The live agent console and handoff queue (UC-21) and the UI 2.0 mock-up (UC-392) closed. On 26 Oct six chatbot bugs were raised for Nareddy Shiva Prasad Reddy, all due 30 Oct: a Highest-priority P1 where the chatbot repeats the same answer when asked for an agent (UC-398), the production API returning 429 because credits are exhausted (UC-399, To Do), discovery-call booking and time-zone options (UC-394, UC-395) and two broken product links (UC-396, UC-400). Ankit Saxena started the authenticated own-records experience and its entitlement layer (UC-19, UC-37, UC-80, due 29 and 30 Oct). The user-name handoff bug (UC-393) was dated 30 Oct. 46 items are past due, down from 48.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Naveen Jangid closed CI build reproducibility (PULSE-9) with its define, implement, verify and document steps (PULSE-278 to PULSE-281), and started on-prem production deployment (PULSE-10) and service health readiness (PULSE-11), neither dated. On 26 Oct b.kumar started the AKS agent migration (IN-1157, IN-1158), closed a PR merge-conflict fix (IN-1192) and started the CSM front-end pipeline deployment (IN-1191, due 30 Oct). The Devops copy of the chatbot Azure Communication Services task (IN-1178) is still in BLOCKER past its 21 Oct date, although the Web-Identity copy (ID-766) closed on 22 Oct. The remaining AKS agent migration items (IN-1159, IN-1160, b.kumar) and the Pulse pipeline set-up (IN-1166 to IN-1168, Shashi Prasad K and Sarath Chandra) passed their 23 Oct date in To Do. 16 items sit in BLOCKER status and 27 are past due; the S1 login error-page bug (IN-1111) is still To Do.
